title: Chapter 5 Revision — Conditional Mood
description: Mixed revision quiz covering conditional paradigm (robiłbym/robiłabym), polite requests (chciałbym, mógłby Pan/Pani), formal address, and gdyby hypothetical clauses.

questions.prompt: A male speaker says: 'I would read this.' [czytać, 1sg m]
questions.explanation: 1sg male conditional: 'czytałbym' (l-form m 'czytał' + 'bym'). 'Czytałabym' = female 1sg. 'Czytałby' = 3sg m (he). 'Czytałbyś' = 2sg m (you). Male speaker, 1st person → 'czytałbym'.

questions.prompt: A female speaker says: 'She would come.' [przyjść, 3sg f]
questions.explanation: 3sg female conditional: 'przyszłaby' (l-form f 'przyszła' + 'by'). 3rd person singular takes just 'by' (no personal suffix). 'Przyszedłby' = he (3sg m). 'Przyszłabym' = I (1sg f). 'Przyszłyby' = they (3pl non-virile f).

questions.prompt: A female guest at a hotel says: 'I'd like to book a single room.' [chciałabym, zarezerwować pokój jednosobowy]
questions.explanation: Female speaker 1sg polite: 'Chciałabym zarezerwować pokój jednosobowy.' 'Chciałabym' = 1sg female conditional (most polite). 'Chciałbym' = male speaker. 'Chciałaby' = she (3sg f). 'Chcę' = blunt present (less polite). Hotel requests → conditional.

questions.prompt: Express preference (male): I'd prefer tea to coffee. [wolałbym, niż]
questions.explanation: 'Wolałbym herbatę niż kawę.' — I'd prefer tea to coffee (male). 'Wolałbym' = conditional of wolić (1sg m). 'Niż' = than. 'Wolałabym' = female speaker. 'Chciałbym' = I'd like (wanting, not comparing). 'Wolę' = I prefer (present, not conditional).

questions.prompt: Formal request to a male colleague: 'Could you open the window?'
questions.explanation: Formal request to a man: 'Czy mógłby Pan otworzyć okno?' 'Mógłby Pan' = formal male address (mógłby = 3sg m conditional). 'Mogłaby Pani' = to a woman. 'Mógłbyś' = semi-formal (no Pan/Pani). 'Proszę otworzyć' = polite imperative (less deferential than conditional).

questions.prompt: Which is the MOST formal way to request something?
questions.explanation: Most formal: 'Czy zechciałby Pan...?' (Would you kindly...?) — very formal, almost archaic, used in very official contexts. 'Czy mógłby Pan...?' = formal but standard. 'Czy mógłbyś...?' = semi-formal (no Pan). 'Poproszę' = polite but casual. Formality scale: zechciałby > mógłby Pan > mógłbyś > Poproszę.

questions.prompt: Complete: 'If I had money, I would travel.' [male speaker, mieć/podróżować]
questions.explanation: Male speaker hypothetical: 'Gdybym miał pieniądze, podróżowałbym.' Both l-forms are masculine: 'miał' (had — m l-form) and 'podróżowałbym' (I would travel — 1sg m). Consistency: same gender throughout. 'Gdybym miała' = female had, inconsistent with male 'podróżowałbym'.

questions.prompt: What does 'na twoim miejscu poszedłbym do lekarza' mean?
options: If I were you, I'd go to the doctor.
You should go to the doctor.
In your place at the doctor's.
I went to the doctor for you.
questions.explanation: 'Na twoim miejscu poszedłbym do lekarza.' = If I were you, I'd go to the doctor. 'Na twoim miejscu' = in your place / if I were you (fixed phrase with locative). 'Poszedłbym' = I would go (1sg m conditional of pójść). Very common advice-giving construction.

questions.prompt: What does the sentence 'Gdyby nie ty, zgubiłbym się' mean?
options: If it weren't for you, I would have gotten lost.
If you were lost, I would find you.
If you hadn't been there, I would lose you.
Without getting lost, you would find me.
questions.explanation: 'Gdyby nie ty, zgubiłbym się.' = If it weren't for you, I would have gotten lost. 'Gdyby nie' = if it weren't for / but for. 'Zgubiłbym się' = I would have gotten lost (zgubić się conditional 1sg m). Counterfactual expressing gratitude: something didn't happen because of 'ty'.

questions.prompt: We (male/mixed group) would go: [jechać, imperfective, 1pl virile]
questions.explanation: 1pl virile conditional: l-form virile 'jechali' + 'byśmy' = 'jechalibyśmy'. 'Jechałybyśmy' = non-virile/female group (1pl f: jechały + byśmy). 'Jechaliby' = they (3pl virile). 'Jechałabym' = I, female (1sg f).

questions.prompt: Which gdyby form goes with 'Pani' (female formal)?
questions.explanation: 'Pan/Pani' are addressed in 3rd person singular → gdyby (no personal ending, same as for on/ona). 'Gdyby Pani chciała...' = If you (formal f) wanted... 'Gdybym' = if I. 'Gdybyś' = if you (informal). 'Gdybyśmy' = if we. Formal Pan/Pani → always 3rd person forms.

questions.prompt: What is the most polite way to ask for a coffee in a café?
questions.explanation: 'Poproszę kawę.' = I'll have a coffee, please (very natural and polite). 'Poproszę + acc' is the most common polite way to order anything in Polish. 'Chcę kawę' = blunt/impolite. 'Daj mi kawę!' = rude. 'Kawa, proszę' = acceptable but less elegant than 'poproszę'. In cafés: poproszę!
